android.permission.INTERNET: Hosted app, authorized API requests and realtime delivery.
android.permission.CAMERA: User-initiated QR scanning for contacts and device approval; requested at use.
android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO: User-initiated voice notes and voice calls; requested at use.
android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS: Message and call alerts, subject to the user's Android permission.
android.permission.VIBRATE: Notification vibration according to channel settings.
android.permission.WAKE_LOCK: Active call and Firebase delivery work, not a permanent startup service.
android.permission.USE_FULL_SCREEN_INTEN: Incoming voice-call presentation; requires accurate Play Console declaration and eligibility review.
android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MI: Microphone service only for an authorized active voice call; requires Play declaration.
